# Legacy Lore Clubhouse

> All-time 26-man rosters for all 30 MLB franchises. Compare lineups, rotations, and bullpens, and argue the close calls.

The Clubhouse builds an all-time 26-man roster for every MLB franchise from that club's own history: a starting lineup, a five-man rotation, a seven-man bullpen with defined jobs, and a working bench. It also offers head-to-head team comparisons, all-time team rankings, franchise history, and player lore. The app is a single-page JavaScript application; team pages live at hash routes under the home URL (for example #/yankees).

## Pages

- [Home](https://dvdjoe-sudo.github.io/legacy-lore/): all 30 franchises and every team roster
- [Rankings](https://dvdjoe-sudo.github.io/legacy-lore/#/rankings): all-time team rankings
- [Rules](https://dvdjoe-sudo.github.io/legacy-lore/#/rules): how rosters are built
- [About](https://dvdjoe-sudo.github.io/legacy-lore/#/about): about the Clubhouse
